definition: Extremely steep and seemingly dangerous or difficult to climb.
author: George Eliot
quote: Still he went on, for his mind was as utterly narrowed into that precipitous crevice of play as if he had been the most ignorant lounger there.
example_sentence: House prices took a precipitous drop the week after we bought.
